focus.$description: The keyboard focus ring's size and place. Its colour is color.border.focus, in color.json. Every link and button draws the ring from all three, as an outline, never a box-shadow.

width.$description: How thick the focus ring is.

offset.$description: The gap between a control's edge and its focus ring, so the ring sits on the card or the page around the control, never on the control's own fill.
